csv_project_name: Developer for Southern Boulevard Affordable Housing
csv_scope_of_work: Township of Chatham (the Township ) is seeking a qualified and experienced developer for the purposes of signing a developer s agreement to develop and operate a 100% affordable family rental housing development on a portion of a site in Chatham, New Jersey, known as Block 48.16, Lot 117.27, commonly known as 405 Southern Boulevard (the Project Site ). It is the Township s intention through this Request for Qualifications/Proposals (this RFP ) to actively pursue an Agreement that will set forth a strategy for the development of a successful 100% affordable family rental development on the Site and the operation of the project consistent with the Township s Housing Element and Fair Share Plan (the Plan ), as well as affordable housing regulations/requirements including Uniform Housing Affordability Controls ( UHAC ) and the Fair Housing Act (the FHA ).
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Housing & Urban Development, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

- Primarily a developer procurement, not a structural engineering or specialist design tender.
- Project is affordable housing, which is generally less aligned with sbp's core focus on bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, and complex buildings.
- No indication of unusual structural complexity, large spans, innovative materials, or sustainability-driven structural challenges.
- Includes planning/master planning aspects, but these are urban/development oriented rather than structural concept design.
- Could involve building design indirectly, but the notice does not define a technically demanding building scope.
